sections.Profile:
Wrath the Cosmic Clown and Talos the Ringleader battle for control of the Cosmic Carnival, each with their own set of modes to clear; finishing both sides wins the carnival and starts a wizard mode. Released in 2019 as the first game from Suncoast Pinball of Largo, Florida, it sets a fantasy-monster cast inside a carnival-in-space theme, with art by Donny Gillies (Dirty Donny) and design by Jon Weaver.
